json.understood: Maya wants a dated launch plan for Fernway with owners from the team and the budget split.
json.title: Fernway launch plan
json.objectWhy: A plan over weeks, like a chart of time

steps.title: Find the facts
steps.does: Pull dates, people, budget lines and the must-haves out of the brief

steps.title: Make the plan
steps.does: Lay out the launch work with owners, dates and costs

steps.title: Review the plan
steps.does: Read the plan as the launch lead and list the risks

facts.claim: Public launch is on Tuesday 9 February 2027
facts.quote: Public launch on Tuesday 9 February 2027.

facts.claim: Launch work runs 4 January to 19 February 2027
facts.quote: All launch work happens between 4 January 2027 and 19 February 2027

facts.claim: Maya owns the launch and the go/no-go call
facts.quote: Maya Lindqvist: product lead, owns the launch and the go/no-go call

facts.claim: Sam owns the app, fixes and the release
facts.quote: Sam Okoro: developer, owns the app, fixes and the release

facts.claim: Priya owns the landing page and the store images
facts.quote: Priya Raman: designer, owns the landing page and the store images

facts.claim: Leo owns the newsletter, the posts and the launch day
facts.quote: Leo Martins: marketing, owns the newsletter, the posts and the launch day

facts.claim: The total budget is $3,000
facts.quote: Total launch budget: $3,000.

facts.claim: Landing page design and copy cost $600
facts.quote: Landing page design and copy: $600

facts.claim: Paid posts cost $1,800
facts.quote: Paid posts in the first two weeks: $1,800

facts.claim: Beta gifts cost $400
facts.quote: Beta tester thank-you gifts: $400

facts.claim: The launch event costs $500
facts.quote: Launch day event (online): $500

facts.claim: A closed beta of about 30 testers runs for two weeks
facts.quote: A closed beta with about 30 testers for two weeks before launch.

unit.quote: Paid posts in the first two weeks: $1,500

items.task: Design and write the landing page
Fix the bugs the beta finds
Landing page with sign-up form goes live
Launch post and online launch event

json.verdict: The plan fits the window and every must-have from the brief has an owner and dates.

issues.text: Bug fixing ends five days before the release: one bad beta week leaves no slack.
The newsletter has no draft step before launch day.
